messages:
Anna: Kicking off MLRush perf POC. Customer wants a short validation: sustained 100->1k QPS, single-turn text-gen, target p50 ~200ms and p95 <500ms. Need a runbook, infra, and two-line pricing for the AE.
Devon: Config notes: model redwood-3-xl, ~120 token outputs, latency runs with batching off. We'll enable batching for a separate cost-run.
Sam: They'll ask about Dedicated vs hosted costs. Need a conservative delta for ~10k tokens/day to give procurement.
Pete: Proposed phases: A) smoke 10m @100 qps, B) ramp 10->1k over 25m, C) sustain 3x15m at 1k, D) short microbursts (10s) to 3k qps. Use Poisson arrivals for realistic jitter.
María: Security flags: they require KMS-backed key, IP allowlist for load generators, and request audit logs. They want a SOC2 excerpt too.
Anna: Can we spin a short-lived Dedicated slice with KMS? Pete, how long?
Pete: Yes. Reserve 2 GPU workers (A10-class). Need approval; cluster should be ready ~2 hours after sign-off. I need their key ARN and the IP ranges.
Devon: I'll prepare the harness and a curl smoke example. Add headers: X-Org-ID and X-Route to hit Dedicated. Example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-3-xl","input":"Summarize this passage","max_tokens":120}'
```
I'll attach the Poisson load generator and a 30-prompt sample set mirroring their traffic.
Sam: For AE: two bullets: (1) POC Dedicated - pro-rated monthly rate for reserved slice, (2) hosted per-token estimate at 10k/day. Keep numbers conservative.
Anna: Add SLA fallback: if p95 >700ms for more than 5 minutes, route to redwood-3-medium and raise a routing incident.
Pete: We'll warm the KV cache: 5m at 50 qps before main sustained runs to avoid cold-cache bias.
Devon: Metrics to capture: p50/p90/p95/p99, latency histograms, GPU util, queue length, batch sizes, KV cache hit rate, and request/response sizes. Hook into Console and tracing.
María: Security blurb: no PII retention, logs redacted, Dedicated runs inside customer VPC. I'll produce the SOC2 snippet and the questionnaire answers.
Anna: Need a one-page results template for Sam to send the CISO same day. Keep it concise: run IDs, cluster config, p50/p95/p99, error rates, CPU/GPU averages, and any mitigations.
Pete: I'll post the Grafana dashboards and exact run commands.
Devon: Expected rough numbers for tonight: p50 ~140ms, p95 ~350ms at 1k qps on Dedicated with batching off. Microbursts will likely push p95 to ~800-1,200ms unless we enable burst capacity.
Sam: If bursts exceed 1s tail, include burst-capacity pricing for peak windows so procurement isn't surprised.
Anna: Action items and ETA: Pete - infra + KMS (2h); Devon - harness + scripts (1.5h); María - security writeup + SOC2 (3h); Sam - pricing bullets (1h). I'll confirm keys and IPs with MLRush.
DeployBot: deploy scheduled: perf-dedicated-mlrush at 2026-04-03T15:20Z by Pete — monitor #perf-runs for logs :rocket:
Devon: Also adding a 10% failure-injection test (503s) to validate app retries and our fallback behavior.
Anna: Great. Ping here when infra is up and we can align on exact prompt list. Goal: first smoke run before EOD. :thumbsup:
